summaries.summary: The user attended Arcadia High School in Arcadia, California from 2010 to 2014, before attending UCLA for undergrad.

summaries.name: University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA)
summaries.summary: The user attended UCLA for undergrad after Arcadia High School (2010-2014) and is a UCLA alumnus. As of 2021-08-20, the user is considering UCLA for a Master's degree in Computer Science, leaning toward staying in Southern California. UCLA's CS program has research areas including artificial intelligence, data science, computer networks, computer vision, and human-computer interaction, with a smaller faculty than UC Berkeley but a more balanced, applied/industry-focused curriculum. UCLA's MS CS acceptance rate is around 20-25%. Notable research centers include the UCLA Artificial Intelligence Research Laboratory, UCLA Center for Networked Systems, UCLA Institute for Pure and Applied Mathematics, and UCLA Center for Health Policy Research. The user is interested in the AI/ML research group, notably Prof. Yizhou Sun, Prof. Song-Chun Zhu, Prof. Cho-Jui Hsieh, Prof. Greg Ver Steeg, and Prof. Margo Seltzer, and plans to email Prof. Ver Steeg and Prof. Seltzer about their research in explainable AI and fairness in AI systems.
